questions.question: Why was Noritoshi Kamo's mother shunned by the Kamo clan?
questions.subject: Noritoshi Kamo/Synopsis

answer.item: However, due to his mother being the mistress to the 24th clan head, she was shunned by the Kamo clan.

answer.item: Noritoshi then continues to talk with the other about what to do with Yuji, where Noritoshi tells them that they will all attack Yuji together.

questions.question: How did Megumi figure out how Noritoshi controlled his arrows?
questions.subject: Noritoshi Kamo/Synopsis

answer.item: As Noritoshi fires arrows at Megumi, Megumi manages to protect himself and figures out that Noritoshi is manipulating the arrows with his blood.

questions.question: Who was waiting for Noritoshi inside the Kamo Main House?
questions.subject: Noritoshi Kamo/Synopsis

answer.item: He went deeper into the house and found none other than Kenjaku casually relaxing in the master bedroom.

questions.question: What did Kenjaku take for himself in the Kamo clan?
questions.subject: Noritoshi Kamo/Synopsis

answer.item: He completely took over the conservative faction and also took it upon himself to become the 25th head of the Kamo clan instead of Noritoshi.

questions.question: Who did Noritoshi and Maki Zenin battle in the Sakurajima Colony?
questions.subject: Noritoshi Kamo/Synopsis

answer.item: On November 12th, Noritoshi and Maki face a powerful cursed spirit, revealed to be Naoya Zenin, cursed after death and seeking vengeance.

questions.question: Why did Noritoshi decline to fight Kenjaku?
questions.subject: Noritoshi Kamo/Synopsis

answer.item: Noritoshi opted to count himself out as he felt he would be of no use and wanted to prioritize protecting his family and flee overseas with them.
